title: Endogenous Parcel Contiguity and Rent Indeterminacy in a Finite-Household Monocentric City
abstract: arXiv:2611.18054v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study a monocentric city with finitely many households, each of which may hold any measurable set of land and incurs commuting costs that depend on the spatial distribution of its holdings. In equilibrium, every parcel is an interval and parcels are ordered by lot size from the center outward. The freedom to adjust land holdings at any location restricts supporting rents to a band between the competing bid rents and the assigned household's bid rent. This band excludes rents that support the same allocation when lots are restricted to intervals, including the one constructed by Berliant and Fujita (1992), and makes the existence of a supporting rent a substantive question even with identical households. We give sufficient conditions for the existence of a locally supporting rent that meets every household's budget and deters all small deviations. translated_title: 有限家庭单中心城市中的内生地块邻接性与租金不确定性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个包含有限数量家庭的单中心城市模型，其中每个家庭可以持有土地的任意可测子集，其通勤成本取决于所持土地的空间分布。在均衡状态下，每个地块必然是一个区间，且各地块按面积大小由中心向外依次排列。家庭可在任意位置调整土地持有的自由，使得支撑租金只能位于竞争性竞租与被分配家庭的竞租之间的一个区间内。该区间排除了在地块被限定为区间情形下支持相同配置的租金——包括Berliant与Fujita（1992）所构造的租金——从而使支撑租金的存在性成为一个实质性问题，即使所有家庭是同质的。我们给出了局部支撑租金存在的充分条件，该租金既能满足每个家庭的预算约束，又能阻止所有微小的偏离。我们还证明，任何均衡都能实现达到均衡状态所需实际资源成本的最小化。
tldr: 该论文证明，在允许家庭持有任意形状土地集合的有限家庭单中心城市中，均衡地块必为按面积从中心向外排序的区间，支撑租金被限制在一个狭窄区间内从而产生租金不确定性，并给出了局部支撑租金存在的充分条件且证明均衡能最小化实际资源成本。
en_tdlr: In a finite-household monocentric city where households may hold arbitrary measurable land sets, equilibrium parcels are intervals ordered by lot size from the center outward, supporting rents are confined to a band that generates rent indeterminacy, and sufficient conditions for the existence of locally supporting rents are provided.
